integrity: Proof includes independent positive fixed-point rank lemma and exact row-sum identities; verify.py provides supplementary symbolic and numerical checks.
scientific_limitations: Equal group populations, equal contact budgets, common removal, two-group symmetric assortativity, supercritical positive-branch limit; early Markov branching survival is not exact finite-population major-outbreak probability.
title: A sharp assortativity switch between epidemic burden and outbreak-seeding rankings
